title: RFID & NFC Solutions for Middle East — Hotel Cards, Event Wristbands & Vehicle Tags
summary: Proud Tek supplies custom RFID products across the GCC and broader Middle East. From Dubai hotel key cards and Riyadh event wristbands to vehicle windshield tags for toll and parking systems, we support Arabic-language branding, regional chip standards, and express shipping to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and Kuwait.
heroPoints: Direct factory shipping to Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Muscat — typical lead time 7-12 working days.
Arabic + English dual-language card printing with CMYK, foil stamp, and UV finishes.
Tested with Onity, ASSA ABLOY, Saflok, and Hafele lock systems common in GCC hotels.
imageAlt: RFID hotel key cards and event wristbands for Middle East markets

sections.title: Why Middle East buyers choose Proud Tek
bullets: GCC hotel chains need RFID cards compatible with multiple lock vendors — we test against Onity, ASSA ABLOY, Saflok, VingCard, Hafele, and Be-Tech from the same production line.
Arabic text and RTL layouts are handled natively in our prepress workflow — no extra charges for bilingual artwork.
Event wristband programs for Dubai Expo, Riyadh Season, and Qatar World Cup–style events require fast-turnaround custom branding at 50K-500K volumes.
Vehicle windshield tags for Salik-style toll systems and parking management need UHF RFID with tamper-evident adhesive rated for 60°C+ sun exposure.

sections.title: Popular products for Middle East projects
Shipping and logistics to GCC
bullets: Express air freight (DHL/FedEx) delivers to Dubai and Riyadh in 3-5 days after production.
Standard sea freight keeps per-unit cost low for large orders — 15-20 days to Jebel Ali or Dammam port.
All shipments include commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin for GCC customs clearance.
We hold safety stock of common blank cards (MIFARE Classic 1K white PVC) for same-week dispatch.

faq.question: Do you ship directly to UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar?
faq.answer: Yes. We ship via DHL, FedEx, and sea freight to all GCC countries. Express delivery typically arrives in 3-5 working days after production.

faq.question: Can you print Arabic text on RFID cards?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Our prepress team handles Arabic, English, and bilingual layouts. We support RTL text, Arabic calligraphy fonts, and dual-language card designs at no extra charge.

faq.question: What is your MOQ for hotel key cards?
faq.answer: 500 pieces for custom-printed RFID hotel key cards. For blank white cards with common chips (MIFARE Classic 1K), we can ship smaller quantities from stock.

faq.question: Are your vehicle windshield tags rated for high temperatures?
faq.answer: Yes. Our UHF windshield tags use automotive-grade adhesive tested to withstand continuous exposure at 85°C, suitable for GCC summer conditions.
